scope: Session-local supplemental tool guidance; standalone OPS source/schema rewrites require an external trusted adapter
protectedPolicy: Do not change tool names, parameter keys/types/defaults/enums, permissions, CAS, completeness, side effect or retry semantics. Preserve ignore/symlink scope and path base facts. SDK loading takes effect next step.

guidance.initial: Use stat for metadata, read_files for content, and inspect for structural information. grep patterns are regular expressions; replacement text matching may be literal: check the tool contract. glob takes arrays; use **/*.js for recursion, not *.js. Check result status, coverage, revision and recovery facts before proceeding.
